::: {.early-intervention-feature}

## Individualized support. Real preschool life.

Our early-intervention center is colocated within a preschool, bringing together two valuable experiences. Children can receive focused, one-to-one therapeutic support while also taking part in the everyday play, routines and peer interactions of preschool. It’s a thoughtful blend of individualized care and opportunities to learn, connect and participate alongside other children.

:::
